__baseline_prompt__.text: Create a cinematic live-action fantasy photograph in which game-like skill rules materially affect a dangerous exploration. Use the attached portrait only as a guide to visible face and hair appearance for a fictional explorer, a woman of 27 with a straight dark chin-length bob, airy separated fringe, large dark eyes, softly rounded face and softly full lips. Her absorbed, alert expression and close-fitting, travel-worn olive expedition tunic give her quiet magnetic presence. A selected ability changes the route through the dungeon. She is crossing an abandoned salt-mine junction with a bronze listening sentinel between a left tunnel and a right exit. She has deliberately chosen a diversion rather than force. Her left hand holds two clearly separate unplayed cards, labeled STONE and SPARK; her right hand presents a larger selected ECHO STEP card, its face toward the camera and one small filled charge pip beside an empty pip. A compact translucent character panel next to her forearm reads ECHO STEP and MP 0/2. A thin cyan trail runs continuously from the selected card down to three luminous ghost footprints traveling into the left tunnel. The bronze sentinel's head and trumpet-shaped listening horn have turned toward those same luminous footprints, leaving the right exit visibly unguarded. Her forward boot is already across that exit's threshold while her trailing boot remains on the junction floor. The newly emptied resource display, visible chosen card, false tracks, diverted guard and clear passage form one connected tactical consequence. Her elbows stay separate in front of her torso; the right thumb and index finger grip the selected card's lower edge, while the left hand fans the other two beside her waist. Both wrists and both hands are visible. Place the card faces and her face in the near middle plane, the sentinel and the ghost tracks slightly deeper, and keep the open right doorway and her forward boot in the frame. Photograph the junction obliquely from inside the right passage at waist height, as if witnessing her narrow escape. A 35 mm lens and moderately deep focus let the choice and its effect coexist, with warm mining lamps grazing granular salt walls and cyan card light picking out the edge of her cheek. Real skin texture, dusty boot seams, dented bronze and uneven salt crystals keep the impossible ability physically inhabited. The image should feel like an ingenious choice made at the last safe instant, with her poised concentration carrying the human appeal.
